name: Zhuang
source:
Zhuang is a rather enigmatic young man whom one day appears in front of Lucia, willing to listen to her problems and tend to her needs.
[spoiler]
Much like Neo, not much is known about Zhuang, other than the fact that he seems to be closely related to Chunxiang and Shuang. Unlike Neo, however, Zhuang has no known background information whatsoever, making it much more difficult to interpret the reasoning behind his actions.
[/spoiler]
